key_insight: When checks reliably identify failures but cannot certify success, learning only from verified negatives avoids rewarding false-positive solutions.
engineering_relevance: NOPO offers a training approach for settings where unit tests, constraint checks, or LLM verifiers can reject failures but cannot establish correctness.
method: Treat non-falsified responses as unlabeled rather than positive rewards.
Suppress trusted verified negatives using a reference-relative loss.
Scale each update by the group's proportion of non-falsified responses.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved pass@k over baselines on code, logic, and math benchmarks, with gains persisting under inference-time scaling and cross-benchmark transfer.
watch_item: NOPO depends on reliable negative judgments; falsely rejected valid solutions could be suppressed during training.
paper_title: Negative-Only Policy Optimization for One-Sided Verifiable Rewards
